in_english.name: Elston
in_english.meaning: Elston - English surname of Norman origin, possibly derived from Old English words
in_english.long_meaning: Elston - English surname of Norman origin, possibly derived from Old English words 'æjl' meaning 'noble' and 'tun' meaning 'settlement', or possibly from the Old English 'æl' meaning 'beauty' and 'tun' meaning 'enclosure', first recorded in the 13th century, commonly found in North Yorkshire, England.
